item.title: Mosiuoa 'Terror' Lekota: A Courageous Leader Who Spoke Truth to Power
item.description: (From left) Mosiuoa 'Terror' Lekota, Winnie Madikizela-Mandela, Archbishop Desmond Tutu, Popo Molefe and Mohammed Valli Moosa lead a march in support of the UDF's &quot;Free All Political Prisoners' campaign&quot; in the late 1980s. In a world marked by division and inequality, Lekota’s life demonstrates how centring compassion in activism and leadership can create real change, says the writer.
